svg.title: Learning to Control PDEs with Differentiable Predictive Control and Time-Integrated Neural Operators
svg.desc: Learn a temporal-derivative operator and integrate it numerically. Freeze this surrogate, then backpropagate control loss through closed-loop rollouts to train the policy. Time-integrated DeepONet supplies differentiable PDE dynamics for offline policy optimization. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
